parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, which is lightweight and durable.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, providing structural support and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glasses in place on the right side of the wearer’s head and ensures stability.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame body of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic, holding the lenses and connecting both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses, provides the main structure of the eyeglasses, and rests on the wearer’s nose.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move; it serves as the central structural component connecting both legs.
